attributes.description: dramatic mountain peak in the background, rugged, snow-dusted face illuminated by warm, golden glow of the setting or rising sun, casting long, soft shadows and highlighting the texture of the rock and snow
mossy, snow-dusted rocks, with some patches of moss and lichen visible on the rocks and cabin walls
row of traditional red wooden fishing cabins with white-trimmed windows and dark, sloped roofs, arranged in a gentle curve along the bank, creating a sense of depth
snow blankets the ground and rooftops
sky above is a soft gradient of pale pink, lavender, and muted orange, suggesting the golden hour with minimal haze
